item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem: Meera watches the Moon from her balcony in Jaipur at 8 p.m. on Monday and sees it low in the eastern sky. Her grandmother says that on Tuesday at 8 p.m. the Moon will look different. What should Meera predict?

options.A: The Moon will be in the same place at 8 p.m. because it always follows the Sun's daily schedule.
options.B: The Moon will be in a different part of the sky and will rise later than it did on Monday.
options.C: The Moon will rise exactly at sunset every day, so its position cannot change.
options.D: The Moon will not be visible at all on Tuesday because it disappears after one night.
